title: Agent definition
description: The runtime-agnostic definition of an agent (CON-03). It names capability classes, never the tool identifiers of a specific runtime version: that mapping belongs to the binding layer, which is the indirection that contains the open item on unconfirmed runtime identifiers. The concrete runtime definition file emitted from this appears only under core/binding/, and its filename is a binding-layer concern that this contract deliberately does not name (ADR-0001, FR-04).

targetScopeRef.description: The canonical hash of the scope contract this agent was defined against, not a copy of the scope. Binding to the hash is what makes drift detectable: if the scope changes, the recomputed digest stops matching and the mismatch is visible before deployment rather than after (FR-23).

accessLevel.description: Fixed in v1. This declaration is defence in depth only: the read-only guarantee derives from the RBAC grant that Azure Resource Manager enforces, not from this property (SEC-001). A definition claiming read-only over a write-capable grant is caught by the RBAC check, not here.

actionMode.description: v1 admits no mutating mode. A value permitting mutation is absent from the enumeration rather than rejected by a rule, so a definition cannot request one and be silently downgraded to something safer than it asked for.

kind.description: The class of model host. An enumeration, so an unrecognised provider fails validation instead of reaching a dispatcher at run time.

deploymentRef.description: Names an external reference holding the deployment locator. Referenced rather than inlined: a literal deployment endpoint in a committed file is a customer environment identifier (NFR-02).

consumptionLimit.description: Required, because an agent without a declared ceiling has one anyway, set by a runtime default this contract never stated.

capabilities.description: Required, and required even when empty. Omission is what this property exists to prevent: a runtime given no list inherits its global tool set, which includes write tools, so an emitted binding without an explicit list is a defect (NEG-D). An empty array is meaningful and says 'none'; an absent property cannot be expressed at all.

skills.description: Optional named skills. Named, never inlined: a skill body here would be a free-form payload field, which no schema in this contract carries (SEC-013).

schemaVersion.description: The version of this schema the instance conforms to (FR-05, FR-29).

identifier.description: Lowercase, hyphen-separated. Constrained so an identifier cannot carry arbitrary text, and English by construction (FR-03, CON-01).

externalReferenceName.description: Names an entry in the framework configuration's externalReferences. The pattern cannot express a URL or a token, so a value pasted here fails validation rather than being committed.

sha256Hex.description: Lowercase hex, exactly 64 characters, as ADR-0004 pins.

capabilityClass.description: A closed set of read-shaped classes. Closed on purpose: a capability the runtime advertises and this contract does not classify fails the build rather than defaulting to allowed (NEG-C). Arbitrary query construction has no class here, which is how it is denied structurally rather than filtered at run time.
